title: Dual Realm Alchemist
description: A three-faced man in a long coat stands at the center of a circular portal, holding a glowing crystal in one hand and a pink celestial orb in the other. To the left, a backpacking explorer with a staff walks toward the portal, while mystical symbols, floating eyes, geometric shapes, and a lavender field under a split black and white background fill the surreal composition.
